author: resto3264
quote:
Played as a kid, now as an adult with cancer and worse health, I can't believe my eyes
The world is indeed stunning, story is beautiful and everything about it gives me joy
The end left me with a wide smile and I can't wake up from the dream

Truly fantastic and I hope I get to play it again...
If this ended as Game of the Year I'd die a happy man
